# Decent Partners: Edgeware, Kabocha Structure, Revenue and Growth Strategy via a MetaDAO

## MetaDAO proposal final delivery

This strategy document concludes an applied R&D phase for the [MetaDAO project](This outline strategy marks the conclusion to the ) that was funded by Edgeware two years ago.

> in principle the idea would be to research a range of core issues facing fully on-chain economies that that are setting out to escape centralisation vectors and to create a 'Meta DAO' to address them that benefits from ongoing investment from a range of projects. 

## **Introduction**
Edgeware is an experiment in grass-roots value creation, organisation and funding. 

It's holders are in effect a decentralised association of members, brought together by a successful token distribution event - [the lockdrop](https://medium.com/commonwealth-labs/whats-in-a-lockdrop-194218a180ca). 

90% of the initial supply was set aside for the public which had the eventual and perhaps inevitable result that no one group could dictate a roadmap, leading to the departure of the original founding team to another network. 

This has led to many challenges when attempting to communicate the project's primary purpose, since it doesn't easily fit within category norms. 

This is a good thing. 

Edgeware is different. It is not a pre-defined thing you can put in a box, it is a process - an emergent organism, self-evolving into a vibrant ecosystem. 

It is a digital community, with organisational and economic super-powers that can be tapped by anyone, anywhere with talent, commitment and vision. 

As a result its 'use case' is entirely open to interpretation - what will you build?

The following is our particular interpretation.
